card.name: The word time after "at any"
card.fires_on: The word "time" in the phrase "at any time", seen in NSAID label warnings about stomach bleeding, ulcers and perforation that can occur at any time during use.

modes.label: At any time during use
modes.description: The word "time" completes "at any time" in the NSAID warning on GI bleeding, ulceration and perforation.
modes.example: These events can occur at any<< time>> during use and without warning symptoms.

card.writes: It seems to suppress words like post, late, long and months, which would otherwise suggest a later or longer timing.
card.plain: It fires on "time" in "can occur at any time" in stomach-bleeding warnings for pain relievers, which means no particular delay is needed.
